title: The Light in the Library
intro: 一本书也许不能替你走路，却能为你照亮下一步。

paragraphs.en: Every afternoon, Mia waited for her mother in the school library. At first, she only sat by the window and watched the playground grow quiet.
paragraphs.zh: 每天下午，米娅都会在学校图书馆等妈妈。起初，她只是坐在窗边，看着操场渐渐安静下来。

paragraphs.en: One rainy day, the librarian placed a book beside her. “A good story is a small lamp,” she said. Mia opened it and soon forgot the rain outside.
paragraphs.zh: 一个雨天，图书管理员在她身旁放了一本书。“好故事是一盏小灯。”她说。米娅翻开书，很快便忘记了窗外的雨。

paragraphs.en: From then on, Mia visited new worlds while she waited. She crossed oceans, climbed mountains, and listened to voices from long ago.
paragraphs.zh: 从那以后，米娅在等待时游历了一个个新世界。她越过海洋，攀登高山，聆听久远年代的声音。

paragraphs.en: Whenever life seemed dark, she opened a book and found a light waiting inside.
paragraphs.zh: 每当生活显得昏暗，她就翻开一本书，并在其中找到一束等待着她的光。

quote: A good story is a small lamp.
quoteZh: 好故事是一盏小灯。

title: A Seed Knows the Way
intro: 成长常常发生在看不见的地方。

paragraphs.en: A tiny seed lay under the cold earth. It could not see the sun, but it felt the spring rain moving through the soil.
paragraphs.zh: 一粒小种子躺在冰冷的泥土下。它看不见太阳，却能感到春雨正穿过土壤。

paragraphs.en: The seed did not hurry. First, it sent a root down into the darkness. Then it pushed a green shoot upward, little by little.
paragraphs.zh: 种子并不着急。它先把根伸向黑暗深处，然后一点一点地将绿色嫩芽推向上方。

paragraphs.en: When it finally reached the light, the wind was strong, yet its hidden roots held it firmly.
paragraphs.zh: 当它终于触到阳光时，风很强劲，但藏在地下的根让它稳稳站立。

paragraphs.en: Real growth is often quiet. Before we rise, we must learn to grow roots where no one is watching.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的成长往往悄无声息。在向上生长之前，我们必须先在无人注视的地方学会扎根。

quote: Real growth is often quiet.
quoteZh: 真正的成长往往悄无声息。

title: The Extra Chair
intro: 一个小小的善意，可以让陌生人不再孤单。

paragraphs.en: On the first day of school, Daniel noticed a new student eating alone. The dining hall was noisy, but the space around the boy seemed strangely silent.
paragraphs.zh: 开学第一天，丹尼尔注意到一位新同学独自吃饭。餐厅很嘈杂，但男孩周围却显得格外安静。

paragraphs.en: Daniel carried an extra chair to his table and waved. He simply said, “You can sit here if you like.”
paragraphs.zh: 丹尼尔搬了一把多余的椅子到自己桌旁，挥了挥手。他只是说：“如果你愿意，可以坐这里。”

paragraphs.en: The new student smiled and joined them. Before long, they were talking about football, music, and school life.
paragraphs.zh: 新同学笑了，加入了他们。不久，他们便聊起足球、音乐和校园生活。

paragraphs.en: Kindness does not always need grand words. Sometimes it is only an extra chair and enough courage to offer it.
paragraphs.zh: 善意并不总需要华丽的语言。有时，它只是一把多出来的椅子，以及主动递出它的勇气。

quote: Kindness does not always need grand words.
quoteZh: 善意并不总需要华丽的语言。

title: The River and the Stone
intro: 坚持不一定声势浩大，它也可以像流水一样温柔。

paragraphs.en: A river met a great stone in its path. The stone laughed, “You are soft, and I am strong. You will never pass me.”
paragraphs.zh: 一条河遇见了挡在路上的巨石。石头笑道：“你如此柔弱，而我如此坚硬。你永远过不去。”

paragraphs.en: The river did not argue. It moved around the stone and through every narrow space it could find. Day after day, it continued.
paragraphs.zh: 河流没有争辩。它绕过石头，也流过每一道能找到的狭缝。日复一日，它继续前行。

paragraphs.en: Many years passed. The stone became smooth, while the river reached the sea. Its strength came from never stopping.
paragraphs.zh: 许多年过去了。石头变得光滑，而河流抵达了大海。它的力量来自从未停止。

paragraphs.en: We do not have to defeat every difficulty at once. Patient effort can shape even the hardest obstacle.
paragraphs.zh: 我们不必一次击败所有困难。耐心的努力甚至能改变最坚硬的障碍。

quote: Its strength came from never stopping.
quoteZh: 它的力量来自从未停止。

title: A Window to the Stars
intro: 好奇心让遥远的星光成为通往知识的道路。

paragraphs.en: When Leo received a small telescope, the moon was the first thing he searched for. Through the lens, its bright face was filled with shadows and ancient marks.
paragraphs.zh: 利奥收到一架小望远镜后，首先寻找的就是月亮。透过镜片，月亮明亮的表面布满阴影和古老的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: He kept a notebook and wrote down questions: Why does the moon change shape? Could life exist somewhere else?
paragraphs.zh: 他开始记观察笔记，并写下问题：月亮为什么会改变形状？别处可能存在生命吗？

paragraphs.en: Some questions had clear answers. Others opened the door to even more questions. Learning was a path with no final end.
paragraphs.zh: 有些问题有明确答案，另一些却打开了更多问题的大门。学习是一条没有终点的道路。

paragraphs.en: Each night, the telescope became a window. The stars remained distant, but curiosity brought them closer.
paragraphs.zh: 每个夜晚，望远镜都变成一扇窗。星星依旧遥远，但好奇心让它们变得更近。

quote: Curiosity brought the distant stars closer.
quoteZh: 好奇心让遥远的星星变得更近。

title: The Map in My Pocket
intro: 目标像地图，真正的道路仍要一步一步走出来。

paragraphs.en: Before her first long hike, Ava folded a map and placed it in her pocket. A red line showed the way to the top of the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 第一次长途徒步前，艾娃折好地图，放进口袋。图上的红线标出了通往山顶的路线。

paragraphs.en: The map looked simple. The real path was not. Rain had turned the ground to mud, and every turn seemed steeper than the last.
paragraphs.zh: 地图看起来很简单，真实的道路却并非如此。雨水把地面变成泥地，每一个转弯似乎都比上一个更陡。

paragraphs.en: Ava checked her direction, rested when she needed to, and kept moving. At sunset, she reached the top.
paragraphs.zh: 艾娃确认方向，在需要时休息，然后继续前行。日落时，她到达了山顶。

paragraphs.en: A goal can show us a direction, but it cannot walk the difficult ground for us. The journey becomes ours through each step we take.
paragraphs.zh: 目标能指出方向，却不能替我们走过艰难的土地。唯有踏出每一步，旅程才真正属于我们。

quote: A goal can show the direction, but it cannot walk for us.
quoteZh: 目标能指出方向，却不能替我们行走。

title: The Sound of Listening
intro: 真正的倾听，是给另一个人留出完整的空间。

paragraphs.en: Nora was good at giving advice. Whenever a friend described a problem, she quickly offered three solutions.
paragraphs.zh: 诺拉很擅长提建议。每当朋友说起难题，她很快就会给出三种解决办法。

paragraphs.en: One day, Sam quietly said, “I do not need an answer yet. I only need someone to hear me.”
paragraphs.zh: 一天，山姆轻声说：“我还不需要答案。我只需要有人听我说。”

paragraphs.en: Nora put away her phone and listened without interrupting. She noticed the pauses and the feelings he found difficult to name.
paragraphs.zh: 诺拉收起手机，不打断地倾听。她留意到话语间的停顿，也感受到那些他难以说出的情绪。

paragraphs.en: To listen well is not to wait for our turn to speak; it is to make room for another person.
paragraphs.zh: 认真倾听不是等待轮到自己说话，而是为另一个人留出空间。

quote: To listen well is to make room for another person.
quoteZh: 认真倾听，是为另一个人留出空间。

title: Morning After the Storm
intro: 希望不是风雨从未来过，而是风雨之后仍愿意重建。

paragraphs.en: The storm arrived at midnight. Wind shook the windows, rain flooded the streets, and an old tree fell across the road.
paragraphs.zh: 暴风雨在午夜来临。狂风摇动窗户，雨水淹没街道，一棵老树倒在道路中央。

paragraphs.en: People stepped outside slowly. Then Mr. Chen brought a saw, two teenagers carried branches away, and someone made hot tea.
paragraphs.zh: 人们慢慢走出家门。接着，陈先生拿来锯子，两名少年搬走树枝，还有人泡了热茶。

paragraphs.en: By noon, the road was open. Neighbors who had barely spoken before were working side by side, tired but smiling.
paragraphs.zh: 到中午，道路重新畅通。以前几乎没说过话的邻居并肩劳动，虽然疲惫，却带着笑容。

paragraphs.en: Hope is not the belief that storms will never come. It is the choice to clear the road together when they pass.
paragraphs.zh: 希望并非相信暴风雨永不来临，而是在风雨过去后，选择一起清理道路。

quote: Hope is the choice to clear the road together.
quoteZh: 希望，是选择一起清理前路。

title: Can AI Be a Good Teacher?
chineseTitle: 人工智能能成为好老师吗？
intro: 工具可以给出答案，教育则帮助我们学会思考。

paragraphs.en: AI can explain a math problem in seconds and repeat the explanation without becoming impatient. For many students, that makes learning easier.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能能在几秒内解释数学题，也能不厌其烦地重复讲解，这让许多学生学得更轻松。

paragraphs.en: Yet a good teacher does more than provide information. A teacher notices confusion, encourages courage, and understands different kinds of silence.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，好老师不只提供信息。老师会发现困惑、鼓励勇气，也能理解不同含义的沉默。

paragraphs.en: AI may be a powerful learning partner, but students still need human care and their own judgment. Technology should support thinking, not replace it.
paragraphs.zh: 人工智能可以成为强大的学习伙伴，但学生仍需要人的关怀和自己的判断。技术应支持思考，而非取代思考。

quote: Technology should support thinking, not replace it.
quoteZh: 技术应当支持思考，而不是取代思考。

title: The Power of One Quiet Hour
intro: 专注不是天赋，而是一种可以练习的能力。

paragraphs.en: Lily often studied with five browser tabs open and her phone beside her notebook. She worked for hours but remembered very little.
paragraphs.zh: 莉莉学习时常开着五个网页标签，手机也放在笔记本旁。她学了很久，却记不住多少。

paragraphs.en: She began putting her phone in another room and choosing one clear task for forty minutes. At first, the silence felt uncomfortable. Soon, it became peaceful.
paragraphs.zh: 她开始把手机放到另一个房间，并在四十分钟内只完成一项任务。起初她不习惯安静，很快却感到平和。

paragraphs.en: One focused hour can be worth more than an afternoon of divided attention. Concentration grows each time we protect it.
paragraphs.zh: 专注的一小时，可能比注意力分散的一下午更有价值。每当我们保护专注力时，它都会成长。

quote: Concentration grows each time we protect it.
quoteZh: 每当我们保护专注力时，它都会成长。

title: What Failure Can Teach Us
intro: 错误不是终点，也可以是一份有价值的数据。

paragraphs.en: After losing a race, Ben wanted to hide his result. His coach asked him to study it: Where did his speed fall? When did his breathing change?
paragraphs.zh: 比赛失利后，本想藏起成绩。教练却请他研究：速度在哪里下降？呼吸何时发生变化？

paragraphs.en: The result stopped being an insult and became information. Ben changed his training and measured progress over months, not days.
paragraphs.zh: 这个结果不再是打击，而变成了信息。本改变了训练方式，并以月而不是以天衡量进步。

paragraphs.en: Failure hurts when it closes a door. It helps when it shows us where the door is and what key we still need.
paragraphs.zh: 失败关上一扇门时会令人难过；但当它指出门在哪里、我们还需要怎样的钥匙时，也能带来帮助。

quote: Failure can become information.
quoteZh: 失败可以变成有价值的信息。

title: The Mirror in the Phone
intro: 社交媒体展示的是生活片段，而不是生活全貌。

paragraphs.en: Online, everyone seemed to be traveling, winning prizes, or laughing with friends. Looking at the pictures, Kai felt that his ordinary life was too small.
paragraphs.zh: 网络上，每个人似乎都在旅行、获奖或与朋友欢笑。看着那些照片，凯觉得自己的普通生活太不起眼。

paragraphs.en: Then he remembered that he also posted only his best moments. The screen was a wall covered with carefully chosen pictures, not a window into complete lives.
paragraphs.zh: 后来他想起，自己也只发布最好的时刻。屏幕是一面贴满精选照片的墙，而不是观察完整人生的窗。

paragraphs.en: Comparison is unfair when we compare our whole story with another person’s best page. A picture is a moment, not a whole life.
paragraphs.zh: 拿自己的完整故事与别人最精彩的一页相比并不公平。一张照片只是一个瞬间，而不是完整人生。

quote: A picture is a moment, not a whole life.
quoteZh: 一张照片只是一个瞬间，而不是完整的人生。

title: Jobs That Do Not Exist Yet
intro: 未来需要的不只是已有答案，更是学习新事物的能力。

paragraphs.en: Some of tomorrow’s jobs have not been invented. Twenty years ago, few students planned to become app designers or drone engineers.
paragraphs.zh: 有些未来职业尚未出现。二十年前，很少有学生计划成为应用设计师或无人机工程师。

paragraphs.en: Good planning now means more than learning one tool. Curiosity, communication, and the ability to learn may last longer than any technology.
paragraphs.zh: 今天的良好规划不只是学会一种工具。好奇心、沟通力和学习能力可能比任何技术都更持久。

paragraphs.en: We cannot prepare for every job title. We can prepare to meet change with useful skills and an open mind.
paragraphs.zh: 我们无法为每一个职业名称做准备，却可以培养实用能力和开放心态，以迎接变化。

quote: Prepare for change, not only for a title.
quoteZh: 要为变化做好准备，而不只是为一个职业名称。

title: Why Small Habits Win
intro: 每天进步一点，比偶尔努力很多更可靠。

paragraphs.en: Noah planned to finish a book every week. The exciting but heavy plan lasted only three days.
paragraphs.zh: 诺亚计划每周读完一本书。这个令人兴奋却过于沉重的计划只坚持了三天。

paragraphs.en: He started again with ten pages each night. It seemed almost too easy, which was exactly why he could continue on busy days.
paragraphs.zh: 他重新开始，每晚只读十页。它似乎简单得过头，却正因如此，他在忙碌的日子也能坚持。

paragraphs.en: A small habit is a vote for the person we want to become. One vote changes little, but hundreds create a clear result.
paragraphs.zh: 一个微小习惯，是为我们想成为的人投出的一票。一票改变不大，但数百票会产生清晰的结果。

quote: Make a habit small enough to repeat.
quoteZh: 让习惯小到足以重复。

title: How to Disagree Kindly
chineseTitle: 如何友善地表达不同意见
intro: 不同意见不必变成彼此攻击。

paragraphs.en: During a discussion, Maya heard an opinion she strongly disliked. Before replying, she asked, “What experience led you to that view?”
paragraphs.zh: 讨论中，玛雅听到了一个非常不赞同的观点。回应前，她问：“什么经历让你产生这个看法？”

paragraphs.en: The question did not make them agree. It made both students explain their reasons instead of questioning each other’s character.
paragraphs.zh: 这个问题没有让他们达成一致，却让双方解释理由，而不是质疑彼此的人品。

paragraphs.en: Respectful disagreement is not weakness. It protects truth and the relationship at the same time.
paragraphs.zh: 尊重地表达不同意见并非软弱。它能同时维护事实与关系。

quote: Challenge the idea without attacking the person.
quoteZh: 质疑观点，但不要攻击表达观点的人。

title: Alone in a Crowd
intro: 被许多人看见，不等于被真正理解。

paragraphs.en: A person can receive a hundred messages and still feel lonely. Connection is not counted only by how many people know our name.
paragraphs.zh: 一个人可能收到上百条消息，却依然孤独。联系的深浅，不只取决于多少人知道我们的名字。

paragraphs.en: Real friendship needs attention, honesty, and time. These qualities are slower than clicking a like button, but they reach much deeper.
paragraphs.zh: 真正的友谊需要关注、坦诚和时间。这些品质比点赞慢得多，却能抵达更深的地方。

paragraphs.en: When loneliness appears, one honest conversation may help more than another hour of scrolling.
paragraphs.zh: 孤独出现时，一次真诚的交谈可能比再刷一小时屏幕更有帮助。

quote: To be noticed is not always to be known.
quoteZh: 被人注意，并不总意味着被人理解。

title: The Journey of a Plastic Bottle
intro: 我们扔掉的东西，并不会真正消失。

paragraphs.en: A bottle beside a road may be carried by rain into a river and finally into the sea. Its short use can begin a journey lasting hundreds of years.
paragraphs.zh: 路边的塑料瓶可能被雨水带进河流，最后进入海洋。短暂的使用会开启一段持续数百年的旅程。

paragraphs.en: Sunlight breaks plastic into smaller pieces but does not make it disappear. Tiny pieces can enter the bodies of fish and birds.
paragraphs.zh: 阳光会把塑料分解成更小的碎片，却无法让它消失。微小碎片可能进入鱼类和鸟类的身体。

paragraphs.en: Using less, reusing, and recycling correctly can change where the bottle’s journey ends.
paragraphs.zh: 减少使用、重复利用并正确回收，能够改变塑料瓶旅程的终点。

quote: There is no real “away” when we throw something away.
quoteZh: 当我们扔掉东西时，并不存在真正的“消失”。

title: Should Humans Live on Mars?
intro: 探索新世界，也会让我们重新认识自己的家园。

paragraphs.en: Mars attracts us because it is both near and mysterious. Living there could teach us about survival and the history of our solar system.
paragraphs.zh: 火星吸引我们，因为它相对接近又充满神秘。居住在那里能让我们学习生存和太阳系的历史。

paragraphs.en: But Mars has no air we can breathe and little protection from radiation. Every glass of water and breath would depend on technology.
paragraphs.zh: 但火星没有可供呼吸的空气，也几乎无法抵御辐射。每一杯水和每一次呼吸都将依赖技术。

paragraphs.en: Perhaps the greatest lesson of Mars is how rare Earth is. Exploring another planet should increase our care for this one.
paragraphs.zh: 也许火星最大的启示，是地球何其珍贵。探索另一颗星球，应让我们更珍惜这一颗。

quote: Looking outward can teach us to value home.
quoteZh: 向外探索，能教会我们珍惜家园。

title: Can Money Buy Happiness?
intro: 金钱能解决许多问题，却不能回答所有问题。

paragraphs.en: Money can buy food, medicine, safety, and time. When these needs are missing, enough money can greatly improve life.
paragraphs.zh: 金钱可以买到食物、药品、安全和时间。当这些需求缺失时，足够的金钱能极大改善生活。

paragraphs.en: Beyond basic comfort, more possessions do not always create deeper happiness. Trust, purpose, health, and belonging cannot simply be ordered.
paragraphs.zh: 在基本舒适之外，更多物品并不总能创造更深的幸福。信任、目标、健康和归属感无法直接订购。

paragraphs.en: Money is a useful tool, not a complete map of a good life. Wisdom is knowing what it can buy and what must be built differently.
paragraphs.zh: 金钱是有用的工具，却不是美好生活的完整地图。智慧在于明白什么能买到，什么必须以其他方式建立。

quote: Money is a tool, not the meaning of life.
quoteZh: 金钱是工具，而不是生活的意义。

title: Why Sleep Helps Us Learn
intro: 休息不是学习的敌人，而是学习过程的一部分。

paragraphs.en: While we sleep, the brain sorts information, strengthens useful memories, and clears away some of the day’s mental noise.
paragraphs.zh: 睡眠时，大脑会整理信息、加强有用记忆，并清除白天的一部分思维杂音。

paragraphs.en: Studying very late may create more reading time, but a tired brain pays less attention and remembers less.
paragraphs.zh: 学习到很晚也许增加了阅读时间，但疲惫的大脑注意力更弱，记住的内容也更少。

paragraphs.en: Good learning needs effort and recovery. Closing a book at the right time can be the smartest study decision.
paragraphs.zh: 有效学习既需要努力，也需要恢复。在合适的时候合上书，有时正是最明智的决定。

quote: Rest is part of learning.
quoteZh: 休息是学习的一部分。

title: Before You Share
intro: 在信息传播越来越快时，停下来核实是一种责任。

paragraphs.en: A surprising headline can travel around a school in minutes. Strong emotion makes people share before asking whether the story is true.
paragraphs.zh: 一个惊人的标题能在几分钟内传遍校园。强烈情绪让人们在判断真假前就转发。

paragraphs.en: Careful readers look for the original source, date, evidence, and reports from other reliable places. They separate facts from opinions.
paragraphs.zh: 谨慎的读者会寻找原始来源、日期、证据和其他可靠报道，也会区分事实与观点。

paragraphs.en: Pausing may feel slow, but correcting false information later is much harder. In a fast network, thoughtful delay is useful.
paragraphs.zh: 停下来似乎很慢，但事后纠正虚假信息更困难。在高速网络中，审慎的延迟很有用。

quote: Check first; share second.
quoteZh: 先核实，再转发。

title: Your Own Definition of Success
intro: 如果从不定义成功，我们就容易追逐别人的答案。

paragraphs.en: Success is often shown as a high score, a famous school, or an impressive job. These achievements do not fit every person in the same way.
paragraphs.zh: 成功常被描述成高分、名校或令人羡慕的工作，但这些成就并不以同样方式适合每个人。

paragraphs.en: One person may value discovery, another service, creativity, family, or peace. A meaningful goal should reflect our values, not only win applause.
paragraphs.zh: 有人重视探索，有人重视服务、创造、家庭或平静。有意义的目标应反映价值观，而不只为赢得掌声。

paragraphs.en: We can learn from other people’s paths without borrowing their destination. Growing up includes deciding what a good life means to us.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以借鉴别人的道路，却不必借用他们的终点。成长也包括决定美好生活对自己意味着什么。

quote: Learn from another path; choose your own destination.
quoteZh: 借鉴别人的道路，选择自己的终点。

title: The Paper Crane by the Window
intro: 一份安静的鼓励也能陪人走过困难。

paragraphs.en: A paper crane appeared on Emma’s desk before an important test. On one wing, someone had written, “Take one question at a time.”
paragraphs.zh: 一次重要考试前，艾玛的桌上出现了一只纸鹤。它的一侧翅膀上写着：“一次只解决一道题。”

paragraphs.en: The message slowed her racing heart. After the test, she folded another crane for a worried classmate.
paragraphs.zh: 这句话让她慌乱的心慢了下来。考试后，她又为紧张的同学折了一只纸鹤。

paragraphs.en: Encouragement had traveled without needing a name.
paragraphs.zh: 鼓励不需要名字，也能继续传递。

quote: Encouragement can travel without a name.
quoteZh: 鼓励不需要名字，也能继续传递。

title: The Bridge That Remembered
intro: 古老建筑连接今天与过去。

paragraphs.en: An old stone bridge had stood above the river for three hundred years.
paragraphs.zh: 一座古老的石桥已在河上矗立三百年。

paragraphs.en: A historian showed students marks left by floods, repairs, and generations of builders.
paragraphs.zh: 历史学家向学生指出洪水、修缮和几代工匠留下的痕迹。

paragraphs.en: The bridge became a record written in stone.
paragraphs.zh: 这座桥成为写在石头上的记录。

quote: Old places are memories we can walk through.
quoteZh: 古老的地方是我们可以走过的记忆。

title: The Empty Chair in the Orchestra
intro: 合作需要为别人的声音留出空间。

paragraphs.en: During rehearsal, every player wanted to be heard, and few were truly listening.
paragraphs.zh: 排练时，每位演奏者都想被听见，却很少有人真正倾听。

paragraphs.en: The conductor said, “Music also lives in the space we leave for others.”
paragraphs.zh: 指挥说：“音乐也存在于我们为别人留下的空间里。”

paragraphs.en: They played again, and many instruments finally became one piece of music.
paragraphs.zh: 他们再次演奏，众多乐器终于汇成了一首完整的音乐。

quote: Harmony begins when we listen.
quoteZh: 和谐始于倾听。

title: The Garden Under the Moon
intro: 白天结束后，另一个世界才刚醒来。

paragraphs.en: Nina thought the garden slept at night until her grandfather took her outside.
paragraphs.zh: 妮娜以为花园在夜里会沉睡，直到爷爷带她走到户外。

paragraphs.en: White flowers opened, a moth rested on a leaf, and a hedgehog moved beneath the bushes.
paragraphs.zh: 白花开放，飞蛾停在叶上，刺猬穿过灌木。

paragraphs.en: Darkness was a different stage where other lives performed.
paragraphs.zh: 黑暗是其他生命登场的另一座舞台。

quote: Night is alive in another way.
quoteZh: 夜晚以另一种方式充满生命。

title: Grandmother’s Missing Recipe
intro: 味道也藏在共同度过的时间里。

paragraphs.en: When the recipe book disappeared, Jun worried that his grandmother’s special soup was lost forever.
paragraphs.zh: 食谱本不见后，俊担心奶奶的拿手汤会永远失传。

paragraphs.en: She asked him to cook beside her and judged the heat by listening to the pot.
paragraphs.zh: 奶奶请他一起下厨，并听着锅里的声音判断火候。

paragraphs.en: Jun learned what no recipe could hold: patience, attention, and stories.
paragraphs.zh: 俊学到了食谱无法容纳的东西：耐心、专注和故事。

quote: Tradition lives in what we practice together.
quoteZh: 传统存在于共同实践之中。

title: The Robot That Made a Mistake
intro: 智慧也包括发现知识的边界。

paragraphs.en: The school robot sorted recycling quickly, but placed every blue object in the paper bin.
paragraphs.zh: 学校机器人快速分类回收物，却把所有蓝色物品都放进纸类箱。

paragraphs.en: The programmers discovered that its training examples were too simple.
paragraphs.zh: 程序员发现它的训练例子过于简单。

paragraphs.en: They taught it to ask when uncertain. A useful system must know its limits.
paragraphs.zh: 他们教它在不确定时询问。有用的系统必须知道自身边界。

quote: Intelligence includes knowing when to ask.
quoteZh: 智慧包括知道何时应该询问。

title: A Roof That Saves Rain
intro: 好的设计让资源重新进入循环。

paragraphs.en: Students noticed how much clean water the school garden needed.
paragraphs.zh: 学生们注意到校园花园需要大量清水。

paragraphs.en: They designed tanks and filters to collect rain from the roof.
paragraphs.zh: 他们设计储水箱和过滤装置来收集屋顶雨水。

paragraphs.en: The project helped the school notice a resource always falling from the sky.
paragraphs.zh: 这个项目帮助学校发现了一种一直从天空落下的资源。

quote: Good design helps us notice what we waste.
quoteZh: 好的设计帮助我们看见被浪费的资源。

title: The Last Runner
intro: 坚持完成自己的比赛也是胜利。

paragraphs.en: When the fastest runners finished, Ravi was still far behind.
paragraphs.zh: 最快的选手完赛时，拉维还远远落后。

paragraphs.en: A teammate returned to run beside him, and others clapped with his steps.
paragraphs.zh: 一名队友回到跑道陪跑，其他人也随着他的步伐鼓掌。

paragraphs.en: The result showed his place; his final steps showed his character.
paragraphs.zh: 成绩显示了名次，最后的脚步展现了品格。

quote: A finish can reveal courage.
quoteZh: 完成比赛能够展现勇气。

title: The Label Beside the Painting
intro: 艺术是创作者与观看者故事的相遇。

paragraphs.en: Sofia saw a painting of an empty room and felt lonely.
paragraphs.zh: 索菲娅看见空房间的画，感到孤独。

paragraphs.en: The label said the artist had painted a peaceful place after years of noise.
paragraphs.zh: 说明牌写道，艺术家在多年喧嚣后画下了宁静空间。

paragraphs.en: The same room carried two different stories.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个房间承载着两个不同的故事。

quote: Art is where two stories meet.
quoteZh: 艺术是两个故事相遇之处。

title: The Science of a Familiar Smell
intro: 气味为什么能突然打开久远记忆？

paragraphs.en: The smell of oranges brought Lina back to her childhood kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 橙子的气味把莉娜带回童年厨房。

paragraphs.en: Smell signals travel through brain areas connected with emotion and memory.
paragraphs.zh: 嗅觉信号会经过与情绪和记忆相连的大脑区域。

paragraphs.en: The same orange may open a different memory for every person.
paragraphs.zh: 同一个橙子可能为每个人打开不同的记忆。

quote: A scent can be a key inside the mind.
quoteZh: 气味可以成为打开内心的钥匙。

title: One Minute Before Replying
intro: 暂停让我们有机会选择回应。

paragraphs.en: An angry message appeared on Theo’s phone, and he wrote an even angrier reply.
paragraphs.zh: 西奥收到令人恼火的消息，写下了更加愤怒的回复。

paragraphs.en: He waited one minute. During that minute, his breathing slowed.
paragraphs.zh: 他等待了一分钟，呼吸慢了下来。

paragraphs.en: He deleted half the words and asked a question instead.
paragraphs.zh: 他删掉一半的话，改为提出问题。

quote: A pause creates space between feeling and action.
quoteZh: 暂停在感受与行动之间创造空间。

title: The Bicycle Everyone Shared
intro: 公共物品需要共同责任。

paragraphs.en: The neighborhood bought bicycles that anyone could borrow. Soon, one tire was flat.
paragraphs.zh: 社区购买了任何人都能借用的自行车。不久，一只轮胎没气了。

paragraphs.en: People complained, but no one believed repairs were their job.
paragraphs.zh: 人们抱怨，却没人认为维修是自己的责任。

paragraphs.en: Students created a repair morning. “Everyone’s” began to mean “ours.”
paragraphs.zh: 学生设立维修日。“大家的”开始意味着“我们的”。

quote: Shared ownership needs shared care.
quoteZh: 共同所有需要共同爱护。

title: A City Built by Tiny Animals
intro: 珊瑚礁是微小生命长期合作的成果。

paragraphs.en: A coral reef looks like a colorful underwater city, yet its builders are tiny polyps.
paragraphs.zh: 珊瑚礁像多彩的海底城市，建造者却是微小的珊瑚虫。

paragraphs.en: Generation after generation, they build homes for many sea creatures.
paragraphs.zh: 一代又一代，它们为许多海洋生物建造家园。

paragraphs.en: Protecting reefs means protecting an entire community.
paragraphs.zh: 保护珊瑚礁就是保护整个生命群落。

quote: Great cities can begin with tiny builders.
quoteZh: 伟大的生命之城可由微小建造者创造。

title: The Word That Had No Twin
intro: 翻译在不同文化之间搭桥。

paragraphs.en: Mei found a word in a poem with no exact twin in English.
paragraphs.zh: 梅发现诗中一个词在英语里没有完全对应的表达。

paragraphs.en: It was an invitation to explain a different way of seeing the world.
paragraphs.zh: 这是一个解释不同世界观的邀请。

paragraphs.en: Translation lets readers notice the beautiful distance between languages.
paragraphs.zh: 翻译让读者看见语言之间美丽的距离。

quote: Translation builds a bridge without removing the river.
quoteZh: 翻译架起桥梁，却不抹去河流。

title: The Town That Turned Off Its Lights
intro: 减少光污染能让星空重新出现。

paragraphs.en: For one night, a town turned off unnecessary lights.
paragraphs.zh: 一个夜晚，小镇关闭了不必要的灯光。

paragraphs.en: The Milky Way appeared, and night animals benefited from natural darkness.
paragraphs.zh: 银河出现了，夜行动物也从自然黑暗中受益。

paragraphs.en: Pollution can be too much of something useful in the wrong place.
paragraphs.zh: 污染可能只是有用之物在错误地点出现得太多。

quote: We need light, but we also need darkness.
quoteZh: 我们需要光，也需要黑暗。

title: A Library Without Books
intro: 图书馆也可以共享工具。

paragraphs.en: People borrowed drills, sewing machines, tents, and cake pans from this unusual library.
paragraphs.zh: 人们从这家特别的图书馆借电钻、缝纫机、帐篷和蛋糕模具。

paragraphs.en: Sharing saved money, reduced waste, and helped neighbors learn skills.
paragraphs.zh: 共享节省金钱、减少浪费，也帮助邻居学习技能。

paragraphs.en: A community grows stronger when resources are open to many people.
paragraphs.zh: 当资源向更多人开放时，社区会变得更强大。

quote: Sharing turns objects into opportunities.
quoteZh: 共享让物品变成机会。

title: The Tree of Questions
intro: 一个好问题会长出更多问题。

paragraphs.en: The teacher drew a tree and wrote, “Why do leaves change color?” on its trunk.
paragraphs.zh: 老师画了一棵树，并在树干上写下：“树叶为什么会变色？”

paragraphs.en: Each answer produced new branches and new questions.
paragraphs.zh: 每个答案都长出新的枝条和问题。

paragraphs.en: The students discovered the shape of curiosity.
paragraphs.zh: 学生们发现了好奇心的形状。

quote: Every strong question grows new branches.
quoteZh: 有力量的问题会长出新的枝条。

title: A Letter to My Future Self
intro: 成长是在变化中重新认识自己。

paragraphs.en: At fifteen, Hana wrote a letter to the person she would be at twenty-five.
paragraphs.zh: 十五岁时，花奈给二十五岁的自己写了一封信。

paragraphs.en: Ten years later, her plans had changed, but she still wished to be useful, brave, and kind.
paragraphs.zh: 十年后，计划已改变，但她仍希望成为有用、勇敢而善良的人。

paragraphs.en: A direction can remain even when the road changes.
paragraphs.zh: 道路会改变，方向却可以保留。

quote: The road may change while the direction remains.
quoteZh: 道路可以改变，方向仍可保留。
